title: Chapter 1027
text:
As the fleet passed through the territory of the Black Star Corps, Lesykes, who was full of confidence, was quickly dealt a heavy blow.

When they arrived at Planet Black Gate, the Immortals that he had recruited with great difficulty in the Blackhole Edge suddenly rebelled!

Not only did these players leave the faction, but they also stole the spaceships that carried them!

The players of any region were used to maximizing their benefits. Since they had decided to leave, they had to take some benefits. Furthermore, it was not convenient to run away without stealing the spaceships. Many players seized control of the spaceships that carried them, leaving the route of the fleet and heading toward the territory of the Black Star Corps.

Some players who did not intend to jump ship were also forced to join. They were all on the same ship. If they fought and blew up the spaceships, no one would have a good ending.

With so many players on each spaceship, it was impossible to determine who the spaceship belonged to. Most of them could only follow the spaceships to the transit station before moving on their own. This was the disadvantage of not having a large faction.

Due to the large number of players fleeing, the size of the players in Lesykes's Corps shrank by about half. Coupled with the spaceships and the resources on them, it was a huge loss. This made Lesykes's heart bleed.

"Crazy! They're all crazy! These people have no morals at all! "

In the command room, Lesykes was furious.

This sudden incident was completely outside of his plan. He was so immersed in the expectation of making a contribution that he did not expect that these players would suddenly stab him in the back and do this to him.

When he was in the Blackhole Edge, these Immortals were still quite obedient. Why did they become so violent the moment they arrived in the Flickering World?

He only found it hard to understand and subconsciously felt that there was some conspiracy behind this. He thought that it must be some organization that was secretly bewitching them. He did not think about it at all.

After all, Lesykes did not understand the players at all. The way he saw it, there was definitely someone behind this. Otherwise, there would be no reason for so many people to riot together.

The spaceships that were taken away scattered and disappeared from the radar. Lesykes gave up after a symbolic chase. The strength of so many Immortals made him very wary. Plus, the spaceships were about the same speed, so it was very difficult to catch up to them. This was the territory of the Black Star Corps, so he had his concerns.

"A bunch of b * stards!"

Lesykes was furious. He angrily left a record in the files of this group of traitorous players, lowering their credit rating.

After doing this, he was still angry. Seeing that half of the Immortals remained, he calmed down a little and rejoiced.

"There's still half of us left. Even if we don't contribute as much, it's still a contribution. At least we didn't come here in vain."

Lesiak did not dare relax his watch over the players anymore. He ordered, "Divide and manage the remaining Immortals and strengthen the defense of every transport ship …"

After this experience, he became even more wary of players.

However, no matter how vigilant he was, when he arrived at the free competition zone, a large number of job-hoppers erupted once again. The players were the biggest force that the Lesysak Army was transporting this time. No matter how hard the rest of them tried to defend themselves, they were nothing in front of these players. These players had stayed until now just to hitch a ride to the free competition zone.

Less than a tenth of the players he had brought from Blackhole Edge were still alive. Lesiak was infuriated.

This was great. He had come all the way to the Flickering World in person, hoping to contribute, but now it was all for naught.

New bad news came one after another. Lesiak soon received intelligence from the rear and realized that even though he had recorded the negative resumes of the first batch of traitorous players, there were still high-level factions that accepted all these Immortals, and one of them was the Black Star Corps.

Lesiak felt extremely uncomfortable. He felt like he had been bullied, and his heart was filled with grievances!

Damn it, why?

It's too hard for me!

What he did not know was that among the remaining players, there was also a spy like Muay Thai Warning, who had been secretly communicating with the army members and betraying the movements of the Lesiak Army.

In terms of faction attractiveness, the gap between him and the Black Star Corps was too huge. Even if he temporarily obtained the players' bodies, he could not retain the hearts of the players at all.

…

After entering the Flickering World, this batch of Blackhole Edge organizations had more or less players leaving, and the Black Star Corps was the main destination for this batch of players.

The faction attractiveness that had accumulated over several versions had caused the number of players in the army to skyrocket. Han Xiao did not even have to do anything, and the leek harvesting had already evolved from manual labor to fully automated harvesting.

In Black Star Palace, Han Xiao looked at the EXP on his interface, and his eyes sparkled.

"This wave of EXP is really ferocious."

The plan to expand the leek farm had finally begun to take effect. The first batch of foreign leeks had been uprooted and transplanted into his garden.

The foreign players had their own choices, and only a portion of them would join the army. However, the number was still considerable. According to his estimation, the number of players joining the army from Blackhole Edge would be seventeen to twenty-four percent of the total, which was more than a million people. Most of them should be ordinary players.

"This is only the first batch. When the players from the other Star Fields come over, the size of the army players might become two to three times what it is now." Han Xiao was secretly overjoyed.

There were many rookies among the new Southeast Asian players, and there were gaps in their class knowledge. It was precisely because of this new force that Han Xiao's efficiency in harvesting EXP soared in a short period of time.

Every batch of new players represented a huge amount of EXP.

"The Southeast Asian clubs will probably also send guild players into the army."

Han Xiao secretly smiled. He did not intend to stop this.

It did not matter who the equipment was sold to, and he could even earn more money. The spending power of the guilds was not bad, and the national wars in the various regions were a business opportunity. Selling weapons to them to fight against each other was a perfect opportunity for him to act as a warmonger.

Furthermore, to enjoy the discount, one had to have a corresponding army grade and contribute to the army. Even if a spy came in, he would have to work for a period of time before he could enjoy the discount.

"At this rate, a few more batches of players will be able to quickly accumulate enough EXP to reach level 320." Han Xiaoxin was excited. This was much faster than he had expected.

As for the large-scale job-hopping of the Blackhole Edge players, it was already within his expectations. It had happened in his previous life as well. The continuous decline of the players' reputation was an important process in establishing the title of the Cancer of the Universe. This was never a good reputation, and it included the fear and vigilance of the outside world.

One of the important signs of players stepping onto the stage of the universe was that players from all over the world gathered in the world server. Their presence would increase greatly, and they would receive the attention of many organizations and be seen as one group.

In his previous life, as the players spread chaos, it caused the overall reputation of the player group to decline. Some small organizations did not dare to recruit players, and the result was that the players gathered toward the high-level organizations, completing the upgrade of the faction.

This was something that Han Xiao had witnessed before. He knew very well that he could not force the players at this stage to become obedient through faction benefits. As they became stronger, they would have more thoughts, and it would be harder to control them.

Players would only have feelings for people they were familiar with. For personal development and an advantage in the national war, they had to obtain benefits and create massacres.

As their strength grew, chaos would inevitably sprout. Han Xiao had always been working hard to develop his organization, and one of his main goals was to deal with this situation.

He also knew that because the army was an important target for players to join, this situation would also be discovered by the various organizations that were paying attention to him, and it was enough to lead to all kinds of speculations.

For the time being, this did not affect him much. Firstly, his position was high enough, and he was strong enough. Secondly, many players had joined other organizations, so the situation was not too exaggerated. The various organizations were at most shocked and doubtful now. However, as more and more foreign players joined, the uniqueness of the army would become more and more eye-catching.

Han Xiao shook his head, and another matter appeared in his mind.

"I didn't expect Evans to have already come into contact with the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy …"

Not long ago, Philip, who had been monitoring Evans, sent back a report. Han Xiao was able to see the whole process and confirmed that the red cluster of light was related to the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. However, it appeared much earlier than the information about EsGod's inheritance.

According to his estimation, this was just one of the sub-bodies of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. It returned to the main universe early, perhaps to locate the coordinates of the dimension. In the end, it disappeared into thin air. It was pulled back to the secondary dimension by the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. The main body of the Primal Esper Ability Entity had not officially arrived yet.

However, this also solved some of Han Xiao's doubts. No wonder the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy chose Evans as its host in the end. It turned out that it had already come into contact with him.

When the red cluster of light passed through Evans' body, those who did not match would explode and die. However, not only was Evans unscathed, he was even energized. This made the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy confirm that he had the potential to become a good host and become a spare tire.

"The date of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy's birth is getting closer and closer. With the current efficiency of gaining experience, I should be able to reach level 320 before it's born."

Han Xiao calculated in his mind.
